description: This file contains declarations of functions and constants related to ASN.1 CertificateRequest structures, including object creation functions for certificate requests and request info, along with associated ASN.1 object descriptions.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateCertificateRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 CertificateRequest object, returning a handle to it.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GeneratePKCS10Request
methods.description: Generates a PKCS#10 certificate request with specified attributes and key pair.

methods.name: AnscAsn1GenPKCS10RequestWithCryptoAPI
methods.description: Generates a PKCS#10 certificate request using a cryptographic API handle.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateCertificationRequestInfo
methods.description: Creates a new ASN.1 CertificationRequestInfo object.
